The background container holds a darker, brownish-grey ice cream. Both containers have colorful, cartoon-style branding with text that appears distorted and illegible. There are graphic overlays of fruit slices (mango/peach) and abstract shapes in the background and foreground.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the red label is completely nonsensical, with characters that melt into each other and do not form any recognizable alphabet or word. This is a classic AI generation artifact.
Text on the background package is distorted and illegible, resembling pseudo-script rather than real language.
The texture lacks micro-detail. It appears 'smudged' or painterly rather than having the granular, crystalline detail of real frozen dairy. It looks like digital noise rather than physical texture.

The geometry of the background container's rim and the white lid/object to the left is ambiguous and physically inconsistent. Edges bleed into the background, and the perspective doesn't align perfectly with the foreground container.
The floating fruit slices (mango?) appear as flat 2D stickers with inconsistent lighting and perspective relative to the 3D containers. They lack proper depth integration.
